trap.label: proposal / objetivo
trap.wrong: What I am proposing a joint study.
trap.right: What I am proposing is a joint study.
trap.why: Falta o verbo ser depois da oração com what; o português “o que proponho é…” o exige também, mas o brasileiro o omite ao falar rápido.

mcq.q: What I am proposing ___ a joint study.

opts: What propose I is a pilot.
What I propose is a pilot.

fix.right: What I propose is a pilot.
The aim is to compare methods.

fix.wrong: I propose that we starts now.
fix.right: I propose that we start now.

rewrite.answer: What I propose is a joint study.
The aim is to compare methods.

rewrite.prompt: Com that: “We should start now.” (I propose…)
rewrite.answer: I propose that we start now.
